provenance.policy: All15 exact formal producer/consumer faces. Fourteen declare Stitch; Stonegraf supplies an alternative price; Master also grants a token ability. Originals immutable; root materializes production frontend.

mechanics.original_reminder: You may exile a creature card and an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to create a 4/4 blue Zombie creature token.

subrules.name: 701.83a
subrules.rule: To stitch X, a player may exile a creature card from their graveyard and an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard. If they do, they create an X/X blue Zombie creature token.

subrules.name: 701.83b
subrules.rule: The cards exiled with the stitch ability are "stitched with" the token. This designation has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other effects can identify.

subrules.name: 701.83c
subrules.rule: Effects that occur when or as "you stitch a token" refer to creating a token with the stitch ability.

subrules.name: 701.83d
subrules.rule: An effect may allow a player to pay an alternate cost "to stitch". This alternate cost can be paid in place of exiling a creature card from their graveyard and an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard.

executable_definitions.reminder: Perform the stitch action with tokens created this way if any are created: [You may pay the cost "Exile a creature card from your graveyard; Exile an instant or sorcery card from your graveyard". If you do, do the following: [Remember the original cards exiled this way. Create a {Number}/{Number} blue Zombie creature token. Record the remembered cards in the stitched collection of the created tokens while those members remain in exile.]].

subrules.name: 701.83b
subrules.rule: The cards exiled with the stitch ability are "stitched with" the token. This designation has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other effects can identify.
